name: Chain Mail
description: A heavy coat of interlocking rings over a padded gambeson. Loud, hot, and reassuring.

name: Leather Armor
description: Boiled leather, oiled against the rain and quiet on the move.

name: Wayfarer's Brigandine
description: A knee-length coat of ash-dyed canvas lined with small bronze plates, muffled with felt so the wearer does not wake echoes in the deep tunnels.

name: Choir-Woven Vestments
description: Layered robes of spore-dyed silk interwoven with fine silver resonance-thread that deflects incoming blows with a soft harmonic hum.

name: Architect's Bronze Scale
description: Overlapping scales of green-black foundation bronze riveted to ash-cured leather, forged for the wardens of the deepest threshold.

name: Mantle of the Balanced Triad
description: A supple ash-grey mantle stitched with sun-bronze and moon-silver wire that turns aside blows without weighing down the wearer's step.
